observed_outcome: Expired ehc2_ cursors, retention floor gaps (stream_retention_floors.min_retained_offset exceeding cursor offset), cross-tenant cursors (without leaking tenant/scope strings), legacy ehc1_/retired-constant-key cursors (ISS-039), and bounded slow-consumer queue overflow (max_buffer_size) each emit a single terminal SSE resync_required event and close the stream. Client recovery via a fresh GET /v1/hud/snapshot followed by GET /v1/hud/events resumes live delivery cleanly, while idle periods emit SSE heartbeat comments.
